commit.message:
Clone Replicate nodes for folding only when there are no other uses

This is a second attempt at fixing the issue in JBS-8386697 (the first
being the one in PR 31976).  The key problem both PRs attempt to solve
is that C2 may fold a constant into an AArch64 SVE instruction even when
the constant is used elsewhere.  While the other PR had a more elaborate
fix that checked all users of the constant for clone compatibility, the
fix in this patch is simpler and more direct: clone the constant for
folding only when it has no other consumers.  This way, if the constant
is used in, say, a debug/safepoint node, then we refrain from cloning
and all users refer to a register result for the constant.
